title: The Wrong Valley: Twenty Minutes at Balaclava
summary: Recounts how, on the plain of Balaclava in the Crimea on the twenty-fifth of October, eighteen fifty-four, a hastily written four-line order from Lord Raglan was misread as it passed down the chain of command, and the British Light Brigade was sent down the North Valley, exposed to artillery fire from three sides. The episode ranges from the two small victories of that same morning to the death of Captain Nolan, who carried the order, by the first shell, and from the way the blame was laid on a dead man afterwards to how the disaster was turned into a triumph by Tennyson's lines.
